文本分词
实体提取
NLP
如何对中文文本进行分词处理，将句子切分为独立的词语单元？
如何从文本中自动识别日期时间实体（如"2024年6月18日"）？
如何从文本中提取电子邮件地址、手机号码等联系信息？
如何识别文本中的快递单号、航班号等特定格式的实体？
如何从聊天消息或文档中自动提取地址、人名等关键信息？
如何识别文本中的身份证号和验证码？
如何从文本中抽取网址链接？
如何在搜索引擎中对用户输入进行分词和关键词提取？
当您的应用需要对中文或英文文本进行语义分析和信息提取时，应使用Natural Language Kit
典型场景包括：搜索引擎对用户输入文本进行分词处理后提取关键词、从聊天消息或文档中自动识别日期地址电话等实体信息、新闻阅读应用提取关键人物和地点、客户服务系统自动识别订单号和联系方式等
当您需要构建智能文本处理功能，如自动提取文本中的结构化信息、实现文本关键词标注、构建知识图谱等场景时，也应使用Natural Language Kit的分词和实体抽取能力
实现聊天消息里的时间地点人名抽取 / Extract time, location, and person names from chat messages
从用户输入中提取关键词用于搜索召回 / Extract keywords from user input for search recall
对中文句子做分词并生成检索词条 / Tokenize Chinese sentences and generate search terms
识别评论文本中的邮箱电话和网址 / Detect emails, phone numbers, and URLs in review text
从工单内容里解析订单号快递单号等结构化信息 / Parse order numbers and tracking numbers from ticket text
给新闻正文做命名实体识别提取人物机构地点 / Run named entity recognition on news articles for people, organizations, and places
从自由文本中抽取日期时间方便创建提醒 / Extract dates and times from free text to create reminders
清洗客服对话并自动识别联系方式和地址 / Process support conversations and identify contact info and addresses
对中英文混合文本做词法分析 / Perform lexical analysis on mixed Chinese and English text
把自然语言句子拆成词语后用于高亮和索引 / Split natural language text into tokens for highlighting and indexing
从表单备注或聊天记录中识别证件号验证码等敏感字段 / Identify ID numbers, verification codes, and other sensitive fields in notes or chats
接入 NLP 能力对文本做语义分析和信息抽取 / Integrate NLP capabilities for semantic analysis and information extraction
do_not_use_when: 需求是部署或优化端侧模型，进行算子开发、异构计算加速，或打通从训练到推理的端到端流程，应改用 cann-kit / The work is about on-device model deployment or optimization, custom operator development, heterogeneous compute acceleration, or an end-to-end train-to-inference pipeline; use cann-kit instead
preconditions: 设备与地区满足Natural Language Kit限制：Phone、Tablet、PC/2in1且在中国境内可用 / The device and region satisfy Natural Language Kit limits: Phone, Tablet, or PC/2in1 and available only in mainland China
工程已集成并可访问Natural Language Kit相关SDK能力 / The project has integrated and can access the Natural Language Kit SDK capability
待处理文本为支持语言且长度不超过1000字符 / The input text is in a supported language and no longer than 1000 characters
同一用户未并发调用同一特性，避免系统繁忙错误 / The same user is not invoking the same feature concurrently, avoiding system busy errors
inputs: 待分析文本 / text to analyze
处理类型（分词或实体抽取） / processing type (tokenization or entity extraction)
文本语言或语境信息 / text language or locale context
实体类型结果需求 / desired entity types in the result

postconditions.statement: 代码中已调用Natural Language Kit的分词或实体抽取相关接口，而非无关Kit接口 / The code invokes Natural Language Kit tokenization or entity extraction APIs rather than unrelated Kit APIs
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify code to call Natural Language Kit APIs for tokenization or entity extraction, instead of using speech, vision, or custom model runtime APIs?

postconditions.statement: 输出处理了输入文本并返回结构化分析结果，如词项列表或实体列表 / The implementation processes the input text and returns structured analysis results such as a token list or entity list
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a result path that takes text input and produces structured tokenization or named-entity extraction output?

postconditions.statement: 实现中体现了该Kit约束检查或防护，如文本长度、支持语言或并发失败处理 / The implementation reflects guardrails for kit constraints such as text length, supported language, or busy/concurrency error handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include validation or error-handling for Natural Language Kit constraints like maximum text length, supported language/context, or system busy failures?
